label: ZKN_VIOLET_0001_000
text:
It carries a seed on its back right from birth. As
its body grows larger, the seed does too.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0002_000
text:
The bulb on its back grows as it absorbs
nutrients. The bulb gives off a pleasant aroma
when it blooms.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0003_000
text:
By spreading the broad petals of its flower
and catching the sun’s rays, it fills its body
with power.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0004_000
text:
If Charmander is healthy, the flame on the tip of
its tail will burn vigorously and won’t go out even
if it gets a bit wet.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0005_000
text:
It is very hotheaded by nature, so it constantly
seeks opponents to battle against. Its aggression
will not be quelled if it doesn’t win.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0006_000
text:
It uses its wings to fly sky-high. The more
experience it gains in battle, the greater the
temperature at which its flames burn.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0007_000
text:
Its shell is soft immediately after it is born. In no
time at all, the shell becomes so resilient that a
prodding finger will bounce right off it.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0008_000
text:
It often hides in water to stalk unwary prey.
While swimming quickly, it moves its ears to
maintain balance.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0009_000
text:
It has jet nozzles on its shell. This impressive
Pokémon uses these jets to charge toward foes
with all the force of a rocket.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0023_000
text:
A very common sight in grasslands and such.
It flicks its tongue in and out to sense danger
in its surroundings.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0024_000
text:
This Pokémon is very tenacious. Once it targets
its prey, it won’t give up the chase, no matter
how far the prey goes.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0025_000
text:
When several of these Pokémon gather, their
electricity can build and cause lightning storms.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0025_001
text:
This Pikachu wears its partner’s cap—proof of
the strong bond Pikachu and its partner formed
during adventures across many different regions.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0025_002
text:
This Pikachu wears its partner’s cap—proof of
the strong bond Pikachu and its partner formed
during adventures across the Hoenn region.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0025_003
text:
This Pikachu wears its partner’s cap—proof of
the strong bond Pikachu and its partner formed
during adventures across the Sinnoh region.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0025_004
text:
This Pikachu wears its partner’s cap—proof of
the strong bond Pikachu and its partner formed
during adventures across the Unova region.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0025_005
text:
This Pikachu wears its partner’s cap—proof of
the strong bond Pikachu and its partner formed
during adventures across the Kalos region.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0025_006
text:
This Pikachu wears its partner’s cap—proof of
the strong bond Pikachu and its partner formed
during adventures across the Alola region.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0025_007
text:
This Pikachu wears its partner’s cap—proof of
the strong bond Pikachu and its partner formed
as the two overcame many hardships together.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0025_009
text:
This Pikachu wears its partner’s cap—proof of
the strong bond Pikachu and its partner formed
during adventures across the world.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0026_000
text:
If the electric pouches in its cheeks become fully
charged, both ears will stand straight up.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0027_000
text:
No matter how high a place it falls from, this
Pokémon can save itself by rolling into a ball
and bouncing.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0027_001
text:
An ancient tradition of Alolan festivals, still
carried on to this day, is a competition to slide
Sandshrew across ice as far as one can.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0028_000
text:
The spikes on its body are made up of its
hardened hide. It rolls up and attacks foes
with its spikes.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0028_001
text:
A long, long time ago, it lived in the desert. With
its sharp claws fully extended, it can run right up
an iceberg without slipping.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0035_000
text:
On nights with a full moon, they gather together
and dance. The surrounding area is enveloped
in an abnormal magnetic field.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0036_000
text:
It has an acute sense of hearing. It can easily hear
a pin being dropped nearly 1,100 yards away.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0037_000
text:
As its body grows larger, its six warm tails
become more beautiful, with a more luxurious
coat of fur.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0037_001
text:
In hot weather, this Pokémon makes ice shards
with its six tails and sprays them around to cool
itself off.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0038_000
text:
It has nine long tails and fur that gleams gold.
It is said to live for 1,000 years.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0038_001
text:
It creates drops of ice in its coat and showers
them over its enemies. Anyone who angers it will
be frozen stiff in an instant.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0039_000
text:
If it inflates to sing a lullaby, it can perform
longer and cause sure drowsiness in its audience.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0040_000
text:
The rich, fluffy fur that covers its body feels
so good that anyone who feels it can’t stop
touching it.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0043_000
text:
When it is woken by moonlight, it wanders about.
But during the day, it stays still underground.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0044_000
text:
It secretes a sticky, drool-like nectar. Though
sweet, it smells too repulsive to get very close.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0045_000
text:
It fiendishly scatters allergenic pollen from its
petals, which are the largest in the world.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0048_000
text:
Its eyes act as radar, enabling it to be active in
darkness. The eyes can also shoot powerful
beams.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0049_000
text:
When it attacks, it flaps its large wings violently
to scatter its poisonous powder all around.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0050_000
text:
Its skin is very thin. If it is exposed to light,
its blood heats up, causing it to grow weak.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0050_001
text:
Its golden whiskers function as sensors.
It pokes them out of its burrow to monitor
its surroundings.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0051_000
text:
In battle, it digs through the ground and strikes
the unsuspecting foe from an unexpected
direction.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0051_001
text:
Its metallic whiskers are heavy, so it’s not very
fast, but it has the power to dig through even
the hardest bedrock.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0052_000
text:
It loves things that sparkle. When it sees a shiny
object, the gold coin on its head shines, too.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0053_000
text:
It has a vicious temperament. Beware if it raises
its tail straight up. This is a signal that it is about
to pounce and bite.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0054_000
text:
If its chronic headache peaks, it may exhibit
odd powers. It seems unable to recall such an
episode.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0055_000
text:
It swims gracefully along on the quiet, slow-
moving rivers and lakes of which it is so fond.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0056_000
text:
It is extremely quick to anger. It could be
docile one moment, then thrashing away
the next instant.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0057_000
text:
Some researchers theorize that Primeape remains
angry even when inside a Poké Ball.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0058_000
text:
It’s very friendly and faithful to people. It will try
to repel enemies by barking and biting.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0059_000
text:
Its magnificent bark conveys a sense of majesty.
Anyone hearing it can’t help but grovel before it.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0060_000
text:
Its legs are newly grown, and it can’t walk very
well. It seems to prefer swimming through the
water instead.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0061_000
text:
Its skin is moist all over its body. The skin on its
belly spiral also feels smooth.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0062_000
text:
It can use its well-developed arms and legs to run
on the surface of the water for a split second.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0069_000
text:
It plants its feet deep underground to rehydrate
itself. While doing so, it’s unable to run away if
it’s attacked.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0070_000
text:
The leafy parts act as cutters for slashing foes.
It spits a fluid that dissolves everything.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0071_000
text:
After dissolving many prey, this Pokémon’s
acid becomes sweeter. This makes it even
easier to attract more prey.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0072_000
text:
Its eyes are as transparent as crystals. From
them, it shoots mysterious beams of light.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0073_000
text:
In battle, it extends all 80 of its tentacles to
entrap its opponent inside a poisonous net.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0074_000
text:
Most people may not notice, but a closer look
should reveal that there are many Geodude
around.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0074_001
text:
If you step on a Geodude sleeping on the
ground, you’ll hear a zapping sound and feel
a tingling shock throughout your entire body.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0075_000
text:
Moss-covered rocks are Graveler’s favorite food.
It consumes over a ton of them a day, crunching
loudly while it eats.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0075_001
text:
Graveler’s entire body is electrically charged
due to the stones it likes to eat. It is a very
quick-tempered Pokémon.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0076_000
text:
It deliberately blows itself up, then uses this
explosive force to jump from mountain to
mountain.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0076_001
text:
It fires rocks charged with electricity. Even if the
rock isn’t fired that accurately, just grazing an
opponent will cause numbness and fainting.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0079_000
text:
It is always vacantly lost in thought, but no one
knows what it is thinking about. It is good at
fishing with its tail.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0079_001
text:
It uses its tail to fish, but the scent of the spice
emanating from its tail ensures its catches are
always lacking.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0080_000
text:
If the tail-biting Shellder is thrown off in a harsh
battle, this Pokémon reverts to being an ordinary
Slowpoke.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0080_002
text:
Shellder bites down hard on Slowbro’s arm
to suck out more poison. This seems to cause
itching, so Slowbro occasionally lashes out.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0081_000
text:
It moves while constantly hovering. It discharges
electromagnetic waves and so on from the units
at its sides.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0082_000
text:
They’re formed by several Magnemite linked
together. They frequently appear when sunspots
flare up.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0084_000
text:
Its heads never sleep at the same time—each one
takes a turn keeping watch while the other sleeps,
switching every hour or so.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0085_000
text:
The strongest head with the thickest neck
becomes the leader and gains primary control
of the body.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0086_000
text:
The colder it gets, the better it feels. It joyfully
swims around oceans so cold that they are filled
with floating ice.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0087_000
text:
It stores thermal energy in its body to fend off
the cold. It swims at eight knots even in
frigid waters.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0088_000
text:
When two of these Pokémon’s bodies are
combined together, new poisons are created.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0088_001
text:
Alolan Grimer will gladly gobble up any kind
of trash, making it a widely used and popular
Pokémon at garbage disposal facilities.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0089_000
text:
It’s so stinky! Muk’s body contains toxic
elements, and any plant will wilt when it
passes by.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0089_001
text:
What look like fangs and claws are actually
crystallized poison that will afflict you at a
mere touch, so don’t get too close.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0090_000
text:
Clamping on to an opponent reveals its
vulnerable parts, so it uses this move only as
a last resort.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0091_000
text:
When attacked, it launches its spikes in quick
volleys. Its innards have never been seen.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0092_000
text:
Its body is made of gas. Despite lacking
substance, it can envelop an opponent of
any size and cause suffocation.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0093_000
text:
In total darkness, where nothing is visible,
Haunter lurks, silently stalking its next victim.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0094_000
text:
Hiding in people’s shadows at night, it absorbs
their heat. The chill it causes makes the victims
shake.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0096_000
text:
When it twitches its nose, it can tell where
someone is sleeping and what that person is
dreaming about.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0097_000
text:
Always holding a pendulum that it swings at a
steady rhythm, it causes drowsiness in anyone
nearby.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0100_000
text:
It’s usually found in power plants. Easily mistaken
for a Poké Ball, it has zapped many people.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0101_000
text:
It explodes in response to even minor stimuli. It is
feared, with the nickname of the Bomb Ball.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0102_000
text:
Using telepathy only fellow Exeggcute can
pick up on, they always form a cluster of six.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0103_000
text:
It is said that on rare occasions, one of its heads
will drop off and continue on as an Exeggcute.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0103_001
text:
As it grew taller and taller, it outgrew its reliance
on psychic powers, while within it awakened the
power of the sleeping dragon.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0106_000
text:
It has complete control over the ligaments in its
legs, expanding and contracting them to double
the reach of its kicks.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0107_000
text:
Its fists are masses of muscle. It takes a break
every three minutes to steady its breath and
mood.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0109_000
text:
The poisonous gases it contains are a little bit
lighter than air. That’s why it’s always slightly
airborne.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0110_000
text:
When it inhales poisonous gases from garbage,
its body expands, and its insides smell much
worse.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0111_000
text:
Once it starts running, it won’t stop—even if it
crashes through boulders. This disposition is
what’s caused its habitat to expand.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0112_000
text:
It evolved to walk using only its hind legs,
which has allowed it to expand its habitat
even onto steep mountains.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0113_000
text:
It walks carefully to prevent its egg from
breaking. However, it is extremely fast at
running away.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0116_000
text:
It maintains balance using its tail, which is wound
up like a coil. It may spray ink from its mouth.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0117_000
text:
Its fin tips leak poison. Its fins and bones are
highly valued as ingredients in herbal medicine.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0123_000
text:
The sharp scythes on its forearms become
increasingly sharp by cutting through hard
objects.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0125_000
text:
Research is progressing on storing lightning in
Electabuzz so this energy can be used at any
time.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0126_000
text:
Wavering flames similar to those of the sun
appear on the surface of this Pokémon’s body.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0128_000
text:
They fight each other by locking horns.
The herd’s protectors take pride in their
battle-scarred horns.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0128_001
text:
This kind of Tauros, known as the Combat Breed,
is distinguished by its thick, powerful muscles and
its fierce disposition.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0128_002
text:
People call this kind of Tauros the Blaze Breed
due to the hot air it snorts from its nostrils.
Its three tails are intertwined.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0128_003
text:
It swims by jetting water from its horns. The most
notable characteristic of the Aqua Breed is its
high body fat, which allows it to float easily.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0129_000
text:
In the distant past, it was somewhat stronger than
the horribly weak descendants that exist today.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0130_000
text:
It appears whenever there is world conflict,
burning down any place it travels through.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0131_000
text:
Able to understand human speech and very
intelligent, it loves to swim in the sea with
people on its back.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0132_000
text:
It can freely recombine its own cellular structure
to transform into other life-forms.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0133_000
text:
Its genetic code is irregular. It may mutate if it is
exposed to radiation from element stones.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0134_000
text:
Its cell composition is similar to water molecules.
As a result, it can’t be seen when it melts away
into water.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0135_000
text:
If agitated, it uses electricity to straighten out its
fur and launch it in small bunches.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0136_000
text:
It fluffs out its fur collar to cool down its body
temperature, which can reach 1,650 degrees
Fahrenheit.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0137_000
text:
Porygon is an artificial Pokémon created using
advanced scientific means. It can move freely
through cyberspace.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0143_000
text:
Its stomach’s digestive juices can dissolve any
kind of poison. Eating things off the ground
doesn’t bother it at all.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0147_000
text:
It is born large to start with. It repeatedly sheds
its skin as it steadily grows longer.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0148_000
text:
It is called the divine Pokémon. When its entire
body brightens slightly, the weather changes.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0149_000
text:
It can fly in spite of its big and bulky physique.
It circles the globe in just 16 hours.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0152_000
text:
Its pleasantly aromatic leaf has the ability to
check the humidity and temperature of the
area around it.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0153_000
text:
The scent that wafts from the leaves on its neck
causes anyone who smells it to become energetic.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0154_000
text:
Meganium’s breath holds within it the power to
revive grasses and plants that have withered.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0155_000
text:
The fire that spouts from its back burns hottest
when it is angry. The flaring flames intimidate
foes.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0156_000
text:
The fur covering this Pokémon’s body never
burns, no matter what. It can shrug off any
kind of fire attack.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0157_000
text:
If its rage peaks, it becomes so hot that anything
that touches it will instantly go up in flames.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0158_000
text:
This rough critter chomps at any moving
object it sees. Turning your back on it is
not recommended.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0159_000
text:
It opens its huge jaws wide to attack. If it loses
fangs while biting, they’ll just keep on growing
back, one after another.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0160_000
text:
Although it has a massive body, its
powerful hind legs enable it to move
quickly, even on land.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0161_000
text:
If it encounters a foe, it will stand up on its tail,
making itself look bigger than usual to intimidate
them.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0162_000
text:
It is nimble and has a very flexible body.
Even if you get ahold of it, it’ll slip right out
of your arms.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0163_000
text:
Since it tells time precisely, some countries
consider it to be a deity of wisdom, versed in
the ways of the world.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0164_000
text:
Its extremely soft wings make no sound in flight.
It silently sneaks up on prey without being
detected.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0167_000
text:
Some fishers weave its sturdy thread into nets to
catch fish Pokémon.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0168_000
text:
It wanders in search of food after darkness falls,
never nesting in a specific place.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0170_000
text:
It shoots positively and negatively charged
electricity from the tips of its two antennae
and stuns its opponents.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0171_000
text:
It blinds prey with an intense burst of light.
With the prey incapacitated, the Pokémon
swallows it in a single gulp.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0172_000
text:
Despite this Pokémon’s cute appearance, those
who want to live with one should prepare to be
on the receiving end of its electric jolts.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0173_000
text:
Since it is often seen when shooting stars fill the
night skies, it’s said to come here by riding on a
star.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0174_000
text:
It likes to sing but is not yet good at it. With
praise and encouragement, it will get better little
by little.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0179_000
text:
Its fleece grows continually. In the summer,
the fleece is fully shed, but it grows back in
a week.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0180_000
text:
Because of its rubbery, electricity-resistant skin,
it can store lots of electricity in its fur.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0181_000
text:
When it gets dark, the light from its bright,
shiny tail can be seen from far away on the
ocean’s surface.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0182_000
text:
After it grows up, it leaves the forest it was born
in to form groups with other Bellossom. It breaks
into dance when it gets excited.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0183_000
text:
The oil-filled tail functions as a buoy, so it’s fine
even in rivers with strong currents.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0184_000
text:
By keeping still and listening intently, it can tell
what is in even wild, fast-moving rivers.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0185_000
text:
To avoid being attacked, it does nothing but
mimic a tree. It hates water and flees from rain.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0186_000
text:
It’s the leader of Poliwag and Poliwhirl.
When Politoed roars, they all cower in fear.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0187_000
text:
Outside of cold regions, Hoppip can be found
practically everywhere. This is because the wind
carries this species all over the world.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0188_000
text:
When the weather grows cold, Skiploom’s flower
closes and the Pokémon cannot photosynthesize,
so it flies away to warmer regions.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0189_000
text:
Beware its cotton spores. If you accidentally
breathe them in, you’ll be racked with coughs
and itchiness.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0190_000
text:
Its tail moves with greater dexterity than its
hands. Making deft use of this tail, Aipom lives
high among the treetops.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0191_000
text:
It is very weak. Its only means of defense is to
shake its leaves desperately at its attacker.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0192_000
text:
Since it converts sunlight into energy, it is always
looking in the direction of the sun.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0193_000
text:
It can see in all directions without moving its big
eyes, helping it spot both attackers and prey
right away.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0194_000
text:
When it walks around on land, it coats its body
with a slimy, poisonous film.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0194_001
text:
It’s dangerous for Wooper to travel alone. They
line up in groups of three or four and help each
other as they walk around the wetlands.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0195_000
text:
Due to its relaxed and carefree attitude, it often
bumps its head on riverbed boulders and boat
hulls as it swims.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0196_000
text:
It uses the fine hair that covers its body to sense
air currents and predict its enemy’s actions.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0197_000
text:
When darkness falls, the rings on the body
begin to glow, striking fear in the hearts of
anyone nearby.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0198_000
text:
If spotted, it will lure an unwary person into
chasing it, then lose the pursuer on mountain
trails.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0199_000
text:
It has incredible intellect and intuition. Whatever
the situation, it remains calm and collected.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0199_001
text:
It creates potions by mixing toxins with the food
it’s eaten. Not even Slowking itself knows what
effects the potions will have.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0200_000
text:
It loves to bite and yank people’s hair from
behind without warning, just to see their
shocked reactions.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0203_000
text:
Girafarig’s tail has a small head. It instinctively
bites at any foe that approaches the Pokémon
from behind.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0204_000
text:
It spits out a fluid that it uses to glue tree bark to
its body. The fluid hardens when it touches air.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0205_000
text:
Its entire body is shielded by a steel-hard shell.
What lurks inside this shell is a total mystery.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0206_000
text:
If spotted, it escapes by burrowing with its tail.
It can float just slightly using its wings.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0207_000
text:
It glides as if sliding. It startles foes by clamping
on to their faces, then jabs with its poison stinger.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0209_000
text:
Its growls make its opponents uneasy. This
laid-back Pokémon tends to sleep half the day.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0210_000
text:
It can make most any Pokémon run away
by opening its big mouth to reveal its
thick fangs.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0211_000
text:
Experienced fishers say they try to catch Qwilfish
in the brief moment that these Pokémon become
defenseless just after launching poisonous spikes.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0212_000
text:
It swings its eye-patterned pincers up to scare its
foes. This makes it look like it has three heads.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0214_000
text:
With its herculean powers, it can easily throw
around an object that is 100 times its own
weight.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0215_000
text:
This is a smart and sneaky Pokémon. A pair may
work together to steal eggs by having one lure
the parents away.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0216_000
text:
Its paws are soaked in oodles of honey. When
nervous, Teddiursa will lick its paws and soon
have a smile back on its face.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0217_000
text:
It is quite skilled at climbing trees. If it comes
across a Primeape while searching for berries
in the treetops, trouble will surely ensue.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0218_000
text:
It’s said that in ancient times, when volcanoes
were more active, there were many more Slugma
than there are now.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0219_000
text:
According to folklore, a sudden increase in the
wild Magcargo population heralds a volcanic
eruption.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0220_000
text:
It rubs its snout against the ground, digging
through the soil as it searches for food.
Sometimes it digs up hot springs.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0221_000
text:
Because the long hair all over its body obscures
its sight, it just keeps charging repeatedly.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0225_000
text:
It always carries its food with it, wherever it goes.
If attacked, it throws its food at the opponent.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0227_000
text:
Since the feathers that it sheds are thin and
sharp, people apparently once used them
as swords.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0228_000
text:
It uses different kinds of cries for communicating
with others of its kind and for pursuing its prey.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0229_000
text:
Upon hearing its eerie howls, other Pokémon get
the shivers and head straight back to their nests.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0230_000
text:
This Pokémon is said to sleep at the bottom of
the sea—deeper than any other life-form can
descend—building its energy.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0231_000
text:
It is far stronger than it appears. If a Phanpy is
swinging its trunk around and your arm gets hit
by it, your arm bone will shatter.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0232_000
text:
Donphan is normally a calm Pokémon, but once
it is enraged, it will curl its body into a ball and
charge at you while rolling.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0233_000
text:
Porygon was upgraded to become capable
of planetary development. However, this
upgraded version cannot even fly yet.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0234_000
text:
It’s said that this Pokémon used to be stronger
long ago when it had many enemies, and that it
was even able to evolve under its own power.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0235_000
text:
The color of the mysterious fluid secreted from
the tip of the tail is predetermined for each
Smeargle.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0236_000
text:
Its intense desire to become stronger and
stronger drives it to recklessly train its body and
challenge any opponent it can find to battle.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0237_000
text:
It spins on its horn while dealing out elegant
kicks. Its horn grows continuously through its
lifetime.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0239_000
text:
It rotates its arms to generate electricity, but it
tires easily, so it only charges up a little bit.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0240_000
text:
Magma-like blood circulates throughout this
Pokémon’s body, raising its body temperature
as high as 1,100 degrees Fahrenheit.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0242_000
text:
The eggs it lays are filled with happiness. Eating
even one bite will bring a smile to anyone.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0246_000
text:
It is born deep underground. It can’t emerge until
it has entirely consumed the soil around it.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0247_000
text:
Its shell is as hard as bedrock, and it is also very
strong. Its thrashing can topple a mountain.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0248_000
text:
In just one of its mighty hands, it has the power to
make the ground shake and mountains crumble.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0252_000
text:
Treecko can quickly scale even vertical surfaces.
It senses humidity with its tail to predict the next
day’s weather.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0253_000
text:
Grovyle leaps from branch to branch in large
trees, moving with ease. It propels itself with
astounding speed and force.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0254_000
text:
The leaves on its arms are as sharp as swords.
It agilely leaps about the branches of trees to
strike its enemies.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0255_000
text:
In its belly, it has a sac filled with burning fire,
meaning that Torchic feels as warm as a hot-water
bottle if you hug it.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0256_000
text:
When it enters battle, the flame inside its body
burns stronger. Its kicks have outstanding
destructive power.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0257_000
text:
It can jump powerfully, clearing a 30-story
building in a single leap. Its flaming punches
scorch its opponents.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0258_000
text:
When it uses its large tail fin, it picks up speed
rapidly in the water. It is strong in spite of its
small size.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0259_000
text:
It is at its best when on muddy ground that offers
poor footing. It quickly overwhelms opponents
that are bogged down and unable to move.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0260_000
text:
Swampert’s arms are rock-hard. With one swing,
they can batter down Swampert’s foes. This
Pokémon makes its nest on beautiful beaches.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0261_000
text:
Poochyena pursue their prey in packs. Once the
prey is exhausted, the pack finishes it off. But
sometimes the prey retaliates, and the pack flees.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0262_000
text:
Once it’s caught the scent of faraway prey,
the leader gives a signal, and the whole pack
moves out.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0270_000
text:
Lotad will gather in lakes that have good water
quality. The surfaces of these lakes sometimes
become covered in Lotad leaves.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0271_000
text:
It prefers waterfronts with plentiful food.
It became nocturnal so it wouldn’t have to
compete for food with bird Pokémon.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0272_000
text:
Dancing with an upbeat rhythm energizes
and emboldens it, letting it face any foe
without fear.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0273_000
text:
Seedot live in trees, hanging from the branches
and leeching moisture. Rows of them can be
found dangling from large, young trees.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0274_000
text:
Its sensory functions are concentrated in its
pointed nose, which it uses to sense its
surroundings. The nose is also its weak point.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0275_000
text:
Legends tell of a bird Pokémon that received
divine punishment for its evil deeds and had its
beak and wings replaced.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0278_000
text:
It rides upon ocean winds as if it were a glider.
In the winter, it hides food around its nest.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0279_000
text:
It protects its young in its beak. It bobs on
waves, resting on them on days when the waters
are calm.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0280_000
text:
It is highly attuned to the emotions of people
and Pokémon. It hides if it senses hostility.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0281_000
text:
The cheerful spirit of its Trainer gives it energy
for its psychokinetic power. It spins and dances
when happy.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0282_000
text:
It unleashes psychokinetic energy at full power
when protecting a Trainer it has bonded closely
with.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0283_000
text:
It secretes a thick, sweet-scented syrup from the
tip of its head. It lives on weed-choked ponds.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0284_000
text:
The antennae have distinctive patterns that look
like eyes. When it rains, they grow heavy, making
flight impossible.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0285_000
text:
If it senses danger, it scatters spores from the top
of its head to protect itself.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0286_000
text:
The seeds on its tail are made of toxic spores.
It knocks out foes with quick, virtually invisible
punches.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0287_000
text:
The way Slakoth lolls around makes anyone who
watches it feel like doing the same.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0288_000
text:
It is always hungry because it won’t stop
rampaging. Even while it is eating, it can’t
keep still.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0289_000
text:
This Pokémon lives lying on its side. It only
rolls over and moves when there is no more
grass to eat.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0296_000
text:
It toughens up by slamming into thick trees
over and over. It gains a sturdy body and
dauntless spirit.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0297_000
text:
It stomps on the ground to build power. It can
send a 10-ton truck flying with a straight-arm
punch.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0298_000
text:
Its tail is packed full of the nutrients it needs
to grow.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0299_000
text:
When endangered, it may protect itself by
increasing its magnetism and drawing nearby
iron objects to its body.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0302_000
text:
Materials from gems it has eaten float to the
surface of its body and can form an infinite
number of patterns among individuals.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0307_000
text:
It meditates to heighten its inner energy and to
float in the air. It eats one berry a day.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0308_000
text:
It elegantly avoids attacks with dance-like
steps, then launches a devastating blow in
the same motion.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0311_000
text:
This Pokémon absorbs electricity from telephone
poles. It shorts out the electricity stored inside its
body to create noises.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0312_000
text:
Its dislike of water makes it take shelter under
the eaves of houses in rain. It uses pom-poms
made of sparks for cheering.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0313_000
text:
It flashes the light on its rear to communicate
with other Volbeat. It loves the sweet aroma
given off by Illumise.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0314_000
text:
It guides Volbeat to draw signs in the night sky.
There are scholars who research the meaning
of these signs.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0316_000
text:
It has a small heart and brain. Its stomach
comprises most of its body, with enzymes to
dissolve anything.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0317_000
text:
It can swallow a tire whole in one gulp. It secretes
a horribly toxic fluid from the pores on its body.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0322_000
text:
The flaming magma it stores in the hump on its
back is the source of its tremendous power.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0323_000
text:
If angered, the humps on its back erupt in a
shower of molten lava. It lives in the craters
of volcanoes.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0324_000
text:
Coal is the source of Torkoal’s energy. Large
amounts of coal can be found in the mountains
where they live.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0325_000
text:
Using its tail like a spring, it keeps its heart
beating by bouncing constantly. If it stops,
it dies.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0326_000
text:
It uses black pearls to amplify its psychic power.
It does a strange dance to control foes’ minds.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0328_000
text:
As it digs through the sand, its giant jaws
crush any rocks that obstruct its path. It
builds a funnel-shaped nest.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0329_000
text:
It generates ultrasonic waves by vigorously
vibrating its wings. After making its prey faint,
it dissolves the prey with its digestive juices.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0330_000
text:
The sound of its wings flapping resembles
singing. Those entranced by this sound get lured
into a sandstorm and become Flygon’s prey.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0331_000
text:
It lives in arid locations. Its yellow flowers bloom
once a year.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0332_000
text:
It lives in deserts. It becomes active at night
when it hunts for prey exhausted from the
desert’s heat.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0333_000
text:
It can’t relax if it or its surroundings are not clean.
It wipes off dirt with its wings.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0334_000
text:
On sunny days, it flies freely through the sky and
blends into the clouds. It sings in a beautiful
soprano.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0335_000
text:
If it comes across a Seviper, its fur bristles and
it assumes its battle pose. Its sharp claws are its
best weapon.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0336_000
text:
Constant polishing makes the edge of the blade
on its tail extremely sharp. It’s Zangoose’s
archrival.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0339_000
text:
It probes muddy riverbeds with its two long
whiskers. A slimy film protects its body.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0340_000
text:
Sighting Whiscash leaping from the water is
believed to herald an earthquake.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0341_000
text:
It can live in impure water, where it doesn’t need
to compete with other water Pokémon for food,
so its numbers have steadily increased.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0342_000
text:
A rough customer that wildly flails its giant claws.
It is said to be extremely hard to raise.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0349_000
text:
It is the shabbiest Pokémon of all. It forms
schools and lives at the bottom of rivers that
teem with plant life.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0350_000
text:
It lives at the bottom of clear lakes. In times of
war, it shows itself, which soothes people’s
minds and hearts.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0353_000
text:
It feeds on the dark emotions of sadness and
hatred, which make it grow steadily stronger.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0354_000
text:
Strong feelings of hatred turned a puppet into
a Pokémon. If it opens its mouth, its cursed
energy escapes.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0355_000
text:
Duskull’s victims suffer an intense chill as the
Pokémon siphons their life-force away, glaring
at them with its bright red eye all the while.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0356_000
text:
Dusclops’s true form is said to be a bright red
eye burning within its body, but no one has ever
seen such a thing.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0357_000
text:
Delicious fruits grew out from around its neck
because it always ate the same kind of fruit.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0358_000
text:
Its cries echo inside its hollow body to emerge
as beautiful notes for startling and repelling foes.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0361_000
text:
It is said that a home visited by a Snorunt will
prosper. It can withstand cold of −150 degrees
Fahrenheit.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0362_000
text:
It prevents prey from escaping by instantaneously
freezing moisture in the air.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0370_000
text:
During the spawning season, countless Luvdisc
congregate at coral reefs, turning the waters pink.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0371_000
text:
Its belief that it will be able to fly one day is
apparently the influence of information carried
in its genes.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0372_000
text:
Its armored body makes all attacks bounce off.
The armor is too tough, however, making it heavy
and somewhat sluggish.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0373_000
text:
It becomes uncontrollable if it is enraged.
It destroys everything with shredding claws
and fire.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0374_000
text:
All its cells are magnets. It communicates with
others of its kind by transmitting magnetic forces
from its body.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0375_000
text:
It adores magnetic minerals, so it pursues
Nosepass at speeds exceeding 60 mph.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0376_000
text:
It firmly pins its prey using its four claws and
large body. Then Metagross uses the mouth
on its stomach to chew its prey to bits.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0387_000
text:
It uses its whole body to photosynthesize when
exposed to sunlight. Its shell is made from
hardened soil.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0388_000
text:
It knows where pure water wells up. It carries
fellow Pokémon there on its back.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0389_000
text:
Some Pokémon are born on a Torterra’s back
and spend their entire life there.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0390_000
text:
The gas made in its belly burns from its rear end.
The fire burns weakly when it feels sick.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0391_000
text:
A bigger fire on its tail and a brighter blue
pattern on its face means it holds a higher
rank in its troop.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0392_000
text:
It uses unique fighting moves with fire on its
hands and feet. It will take on any opponent.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0393_000
text:
It doesn’t like to be taken care of. It’s difficult to
bond with since it won’t listen to its Trainer.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0394_000
text:
Because every Prinplup considers itself to be the
most important, they can never form a group.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0395_000
text:
It avoids unnecessary disputes, but it will
mercilessly decimate anything that threatens
the safety of its colony.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0396_000
text:
Because they are weak individually, they form
groups. However, they bicker if the group grows
too big.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0397_000
text:
They maintain huge flocks, although fierce
scuffles break out between various flocks.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0398_000
text:
It never stops attacking even if it is injured.
It fusses over the shape of its comb.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0401_000
text:
When its antennae hit each other, it sounds like
the music of a xylophone.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0402_000
text:
There is a village that hosts a contest based on
the amazingly variable cries of this Pokémon.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0403_000
text:
The extension and contraction of its muscles
generates electricity. Its fur glows when it’s
in trouble.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0404_000
text:
By gathering their tails together, they collectively
generate powerful electricity from their claws.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0405_000
text:
Luxray’s ability to see through objects comes in
handy when it’s scouting for danger.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0408_000
text:
Cranidos toughen up their already sturdy
heads by headbutting one another.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0409_000
text:
If two were to smash their heads together, their
foot-thick skulls would keep them from fainting.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0410_000
text:
This Pokémon lived in primeval jungles. It’s
thought that Shieldon had few enemies thanks
to its sturdy face.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0411_000
text:
Bastiodon live in herds. When assaulted by
enemies, they line up side by side and use
their hard faces to block attacks.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0415_000
text:
The trio is together from birth. It constantly
gathers nectar from flowers to please Vespiquen.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0416_000
text:
It raises grubs in the holes in its body. It secretes
pheromones to control Combee.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0417_000
text:
A pair may be seen rubbing their cheek pouches
together in an effort to share stored electricity.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0418_000
text:
It inflates its flotation sac, keeping its face above
water in order to watch for prey movement.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0419_000
text:
It is a common sight around fishing ports. It is
known to rescue people and help fishers carry
what they caught.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0422_000
text:
It oozes a purple fluid to deter enemies.
Apparently, there are more West Sea Shellos
now than there were in the past.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0422_001
text:
This Pokémon can often be seen along seashores.
It’s capable of spending a limited amount of time
on land.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0423_000
text:
It appears on beaches where the waters are
shallow. Once it catches prey, it will slowly melt
them with its mucus before slurping them up.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0423_001
text:
Fishers say that they didn’t see many of these
Pokémon in the past, but this form of Gastrodon
is now increasing in number.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0424_000
text:
Split into two, the tails are so adept at handling
and doing things that Ambipom rarely uses its
hands.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0425_000
text:
Because of the way it floats aimlessly, an old
folktale calls it a “signpost for wandering spirits.”

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0426_000
text:
They carry people and Pokémon, but the
wind can catch them, so there can’t be a
fixed destination.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0429_000
text:
Its cries sound like incantations to torment the
foe. It appears where you least expect it.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0430_000
text:
A single cry from this nocturnal Pokémon, and
more than 100 of its Murkrow cronies will
assemble.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0433_000
text:
It emits high-frequency cries that people can’t
hear. Once it starts, it can cry for an awfully
long time.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0434_000
text:
The foul fluid from its rear is so revolting that it
can make people feel queasy up to a mile and a
quarter away.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0435_000
text:
It attacks by spraying a repugnant fluid from its
tail, but the stench dulls after a few squirts.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0436_000
text:
They are found in ancient tombs. The patterns on
their backs are said to be imbued with mysterious
power.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0437_000
text:
It brought rains by opening portals to another
world. It was revered as a bringer of plentiful
harvests.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0438_000
text:
From its eyes, it can expel excess moisture from
its body. This liquid is similar in composition to
human sweat.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0440_000
text:
It carefully carries a round, white rock that it
thinks is an egg. It’s bothered by how curly its
hair looks.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0442_000
text:
It was formed by uniting 108 spirits. It has been
bound to the Odd Keystone to keep it from
doing any mischief.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0443_000
text:
It nests in horizontal holes warmed by geothermal
heat. Foes who get too close can expect to be
pounced on and bitten.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0444_000
text:
It loves sparkly things. It seeks treasures in caves
and hoards the loot in its nest.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0445_000
text:
The protuberances on its head serve as sensors.
It can even detect distant prey.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0446_000
text:
When it is voraciously gulping down food,
it forgets about the food it has hidden under
its fur.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0447_000
text:
It has the peculiar power of being able to see
emotions, such as joy and rage, in the form
of waves.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0448_000
text:
A well-trained one can use its aura to identify
and take in the feelings of creatures over half a
mile away.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0449_000
text:
It shrouds itself in sand to ward off germs.
It travels easily through the sands of the desert.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0450_000
text:
It brandishes its gaping mouth in a display of
fearsome strength. It raises vast quantities of
sand while attacking.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0453_000
text:
It rarely fights fairly, but that is strictly to ensure
survival. It is popular as a mascot.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0454_000
text:
It has a poison sac at its throat. When it croaks,
the stored poison is churned for greater potency.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0456_000
text:
It absorbs sunlight with the pink areas of its skin,
which then shine. This appears to be a form of
camouflage.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0457_000
text:
Lumineon swimming in the darkness of the deep
sea look like stars shining in the night sky.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0459_000
text:
Seemingly curious about people, they gather
around footsteps they find on snowy mountains.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0460_000
text:
They appear when the snow flowers bloom.
When the petals fall, they retreat to places
unknown again.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0461_000
text:
They travel in groups of four or five, leaving signs
for one another on trees and rocks. They bring
down their prey with coordinated attacks.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0462_000
text:
Exposure to a special magnetic field changed
Magneton’s molecular structure, turning it into
Magnezone.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0464_000
text:
A Rhyperior’s brain is smaller than a Rhydon’s,
but the Rhyperior is stronger because it spends
more energy on battling and less on brainpower.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0466_000
text:
This Pokémon presses the tips of its tails onto
an opponent and instantly sends over 20,000
volts of high-voltage electricity through them.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0467_000
text:
They dwell in volcanic craters. It’s said that
only a single pair of Magmortar will inhabit
any given volcano.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0469_000
text:
Its jaw power is incredible. It is adept at biting
apart foes while flying by at high speed.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0470_000
text:
The younger they are, the more they smell like
fresh grass. With age, their fragrance takes on the
odor of fallen leaves.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0471_000
text:
It lowers its body heat to freeze its fur. The hairs
then become like needles it can fire.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0472_000
text:
It flies soundlessly through the sky. It catches
prey with its long tail, then lunges at the
prey’s vulnerable spots with its fangs.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0473_000
text:
A frozen one was dug up from soil dating back
10,000 years. It woke up, to much amazement.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0474_000
text:
Its programming was modified to enable it to
operate in other dimensions. This did not work as
planned.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0475_000
text:
Because it can sense what its foe is thinking,
its attacks burst out first, fast, and fierce.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0476_000
text:
Probopass radiates such a powerful magnetic
field that nearby electrical appliances are
rendered useless while it’s around.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0477_000
text:
It comes and goes between this world and the
afterlife. People fear this Pokémon because it is
said to suck in lost spirits and take them along.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0478_000
text:
It freezes prey by blowing its −58 degree
Fahrenheit breath. It is said to then secretly
display its prey.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0479_000
text:
Research continues on this Pokémon, which could
be the power source of a unique motor.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0479_001
text:
This Rotom has possessed a convection
microwave oven. It will sear the surrounding
area with its burning heat, then smile in delight.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0479_002
text:
The model of washing machine that Rotom
can inspirit has been discontinued, so these
appliances are now traded at high prices.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0479_003
text:
The special motor within the refrigerator is the
key to bringing about Rotom’s change in form.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0479_004
text:
There are several appliances that Rotom can
inspirit, but the first one to be developed was
the electric fan.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0479_005
text:
This Rotom has possessed a lawn mower. It will
mow down grass and flowers, then swagger
around with pride at its accomplishments.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0495_000
text:
It prefers to avoid groups. In its day-to-day life,
it dexterously controls its vines to compensate
for its short arms.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0496_000
text:
Servine’s one weakness is its inflated sense of
pride. It takes a while for Servine to be able to
cooperate with other Pokémon.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0497_000
text:
An intimidating gaze and majestic appearance
have caused this Pokémon to be known as the
Lord of the Forest.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0498_000
text:
This Pokémon is a ravenous glutton. It uses its
excellent sense of smell to find food, then cooks
it to a crisp before eating.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0499_000
text:
When defending its friends, Pignite will stand
up to any opponent, no matter how strong. But
it’s powerless when faced with an empty stomach.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0500_000
text:
The direr the situation, the more it seems to
enjoy itself. The flames around its neck intensify,
too, increasing Emboar’s power and speed.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0501_000
text:
It’s said that Oshawott learned to maintain its
scalchop with riverbed stones by mimicking
humans it saw using whetstones.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0502_000
text:
Dewott has a studious and stern personality.
It masters the use of its scalchops through
dedicated, repeated training.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0503_000
text:
Samurott leads its group strictly. Those who do
not follow its rules receive a merciless thrashing.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0522_000
text:
This Pokémon prefers places with lots of lightning
strikes. It catches lightning with its mane and
stores the electricity within its body.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0523_000
text:
Once the herd hears thunder, it chases after the
storm clouds so that the Blitzle in the group can
use the lightning to charge up.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0529_000
text:
It makes its way swiftly through the soil by putting
both claws together and rotating at high speed.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0530_000
text:
Its drill, which has evolved into steel, is strong
enough to bore through iron plates. This
Pokémon is a great help in tunnel construction.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0532_000
text:
It fights by swinging a piece of lumber around.
It is close to evolving when it can handle heavy
lumber without difficulty.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0533_000
text:
This Pokémon is so muscular and strongly built
that even a group of wrestlers could not make it
budge an inch.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0534_000
text:
Rather than rely on their strength, they master
moves that make good use of centrifugal force
to swing around concrete.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0540_000
text:
The bumps on their heads are sensory organs.
When Sewaddle meet, they greet each other
by rubbing these bumps together.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0541_000
text:
Swadloon wraps itself in leaves for protection.
It uses the two leaves atop its head to detect air
movements and feel out its surroundings.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0542_000
text:
It fashions clothing from woven leaves. Though
gentle in disposition, it will show no mercy to
foes who target young Pokémon.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0546_000
text:
When attacked, it escapes by shooting cotton
from its body. The cotton serves as a decoy to
distract the attacker.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0547_000
text:
It rides on the wind and slips into people’s
homes. After it has turned a room into a cotton-
filled mess, it giggles to itself and takes off.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0548_000
text:
If the leaves on its head are pruned with
regularity, this Pokémon can be grown into
a fine plump shape.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0549_000
text:
No matter how much time and money is spent
raising it, its flowers are the most beautiful when
they bloom in the wild.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0550_000
text:
It’s so vicious that it’s called the Thug of the
River. Yet Basculin is still targeted by predators,
such as Dondozo and Bombirdier.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0550_001
text:
The power of its jaws is immense—enough to
leave teeth marks in iron sheets. Its personality
is also extremely vicious.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0550_002
text:
Its ecology is starkly different from that of other
Basculin, so theories that it’s a totally different
species have gained traction in recent years.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0551_000
text:
They live hidden under hot desert sands in order
to keep their body temperature from dropping.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0552_000
text:
Thanks to the special membrane covering its
eyes, it can see its surroundings clearly, even in
the middle of the night.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0553_000
text:
Its unique faculty of sight can detect small prey
more than 30 miles away, even in the midst of
a sandstorm.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0559_000
text:
It will abruptly headbutt anyone that makes eye
contact with it. Its skull is extremely hard.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0560_000
text:
This Pokémon may be rude, but it takes very
good care of its family, its friends, and its turf.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0570_000
text:
To protect themselves from danger, they hide
their true identities by transforming into people
and Pokémon.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0571_000
text:
Each has the ability to fool a large group of
people simultaneously. They protect their lair
with illusory scenery.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0572_000
text:
These Pokémon like things neat and tidy. They
are always sweeping and dusting their habitat,
using their tails as brooms.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0573_000
text:
The oil that seeps from its body is really smooth.
For people troubled by bad skin, this oil is an
effective treatment.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0574_000
text:
Beware of touching the ribbon-shaped feelers
that control its psychic power. Gothita will begin
bawling if you do.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0575_000
text:
Using its psychic power, it arranges pebbles to
form the shapes of constellations. Some people
believe this Pokémon came from outer space.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0576_000
text:
It gazes at the stars to predict the future. It acts
somewhat detached because it has seen the end
of all existence.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0577_000
text:
They drive away attackers by unleashing psychic
power. They can use telepathy to talk with others.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0578_000
text:
When their brains, now divided in two, are
thinking the same thoughts, these Pokémon
exhibit their maximum power.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0579_000
text:
When Reuniclus shake hands, a network
forms between their brains, increasing their
psychic power.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0580_000
text:
It strengthens its body by diving into the depths
of ponds, swimming around while looking for
bog moss to eat.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0581_000
text:
It’s said that many artists have taken inspiration
from the sight of a Swanna performing a beautiful
dance in the light of dawn.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0585_000
text:
Despite Deerling’s adorable appearance, farmers
consider it a nuisance since it loves plant shoots
and will eat them all up.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0585_001
text:
Deerling have different scents depending on the
season. When a distinct grassy smell starts to waft
from one, you know that summer has begun.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0585_002
text:
Deerling have different scents depending on the
season. In this form, Deerling have a softly sweet
scent that lingers in the nose.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0585_003
text:
This Pokémon will playfully headbutt those it gets
along well with. It has antlers hidden under its
flower, so the headbutts are a little painful.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0586_000
text:
There are many Sawsbuck enthusiasts. The paler
the pink flowers that bloom on its antlers, the
more beautiful the Sawsbuck is considered to be.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0586_001
text:
This Pokémon’s leaves can be made into a black
tea, the taste of which varies depending on the
region of origin. Paldea’s is especially aromatic.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0586_002
text:
Sawsbuck in their Autumn Form are known for
having very short tempers. The males fight each
other incessantly.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0586_003
text:
Though there are many enthusiasts for Sawsbuck
as a species, this seasonal form in particular is
not very popular.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0590_000
text:
This Pokémon prefers damp places. It spurts out
poison spores to repel approaching enemies.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0591_000
text:
Amoonguss mimics Poké Balls. It is not yet
clear whether this mimicry is effective against
other Pokémon.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0594_000
text:
They float upon the open sea. Many water
Pokémon gather in the area around Alomomola.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0595_000
text:
Since it can’t generate its own electricity, it sticks
onto large-bodied Pokémon and absorbs static
electricity.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0596_000
text:
When attacked, they create an electric
barrier by spitting out many electrically
charged threads.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0602_000
text:
These Pokémon move in schools. They have an
electricity-generating organ, so they discharge
electricity if in danger.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0603_000
text:
These Pokémon have a big appetite. When they
spot their prey, they attack it and paralyze it with
electricity.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0604_000
text:
It latches on to prey with its sucker mouth,
sinking in its fangs and shocking the prey with
powerful electricity.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0607_000
text:
While shining a light and pretending to be a
guide, it leeches off the life-force of any who
follow it.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0608_000
text:
The spirits it absorbs fuel its baleful fire. It hangs
around hospitals waiting for people to pass on.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0609_000
text:
It absorbs spirits, which it then burns. By waving
the flames on its arms, it puts its foes into a
hypnotic trance.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0610_000
text:
If you see peculiar teeth marks on boulders or
trees, it means an Axew is likely living nearby.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0611_000
text:
Fraxure uses its thick tusks to neatly cut prey into
two portions—one to eat now and one to save
for later.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0612_000
text:
It overwhelms enemies with its prized tusks,
which are sharp enough to cut through a metal
transmission tower in one strike.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0613_000
text:
When Cubchoo starts sneezing, watch out!
If it spatters you with its frosty snot, you’ll
get frostbite.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0614_000
text:
Feared as the Snow-White Demon in northern
lands, Beartic uses its frosty claws and fangs
to attack prey.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0615_000
text:
Cryogonal uses its chains of ice to constrict its
opponents and then flash-freezes them where
they stand.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0619_000
text:
They seclude themselves in the mountains and
devote themselves to training. The form of their
kicks and chops differs from pack to pack.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0620_000
text:
Using the long fur on its arms like whips, it
launches into combo attacks that, once started,
no one can stop.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0622_000
text:
Its movements are powered by a mysterious
energy. It has continued to move since ancient
times, so its power may soon run out.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0623_000
text:
Golurk were created by ancient people to
protect both people and Pokémon. They run
on a mysterious energy.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0624_000
text:
Any chips in its blades would prove fatal for it.
After each battle, it diligently maintains its
blades using its favorite sharpening stone.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0625_000
text:
Bisharp mercilessly cuts its opponents to pieces
with the sharp blades covering its body. It will do
anything to win.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0627_000
text:
With its sharp claws, this Pokémon pierces its
prey, and then it pecks at them. Although it also
consumes berries, it’s a carnivore at heart.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0628_000
text:
For the sake of its friends, this brave warrior of
the sky will not stop battling, even if injured.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0629_000
text:
Its healthy appetite leads to visible growth spurts.
It often has to replace the bones it wears as its
size increases.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0630_000
text:
Watching from the sky, they attack weakened
prey on the ground. They have a habit of
decorating themselves with bones.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0633_000
text:
It nests deep inside a cave. Food there is scarce,
so Deino will sink its teeth into anything that
moves and attempt to eat it.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0634_000
text:
The two heads have different likes and dislikes.
Because the heads fight with each other, Zweilous
gets stronger without needing to rely on others.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0635_000
text:
It’s said that Hydreigon grew ferocious because
people in times long past loathed it, considering
it to be evil incarnate and attacking it relentlessly.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0636_000
text:
In ancient times, Larvesta was worshiped as the
emissary of the sun. However, it was also viewed
as a burden since it often caused forest fires.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0637_000
text:
This Pokémon scatters burning scales. Most of the
danger of these scales is not in their heat—it’s in
the way they rob the surrounding air of oxygen.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0650_000
text:
Eating lots of berries makes the bark shell that
covers Chespin’s head and body grow sturdier.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0651_000
text:
It can send a trailer flying with a tackle. It’s numb
to pain, so even violent collisions don’t faze it.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0652_000
text:
Its gentle disposition would have it avoid
conflict, but it gives opponents a thrashing with
its thorned fists when the situation calls for it.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0653_000
text:
Twigs make for Fennekin’s snacks. When it
nibbles on twigs, it finds the courage to face
strong foes.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0654_000
text:
Braixen’s branch ignites as it’s pulled from the
Pokémon’s tail. Braixen then uses the flame to
spark powerful attacks.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0655_000
text:
It controls flames telekinetically, trapping its
foes in a fiery vortex surpassing 5,400 degrees
Fahrenheit and burning them to a crisp.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0656_000
text:
It utilizes its extraordinary jumping abilities to
flummox its foes, throwing springy bubbles
at them from above their heads.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0657_000
text:
The tips of its fingers and toes stick firmly to
vertical surfaces. Frogadier can scale skyscrapers
with ease.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0658_000
text:
It makes shuriken out of mucus excreted from its
thighs. These shuriken can cut cleanly through
steel cables.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0661_000
text:
Fletchling can be found in both rural and urban
areas. They once had a huge territorial dispute
with Squawkabilly. Fights broke out all over town.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0662_000
text:
Its territory has a radius of just over a mile.
If any bird Pokémon should enter, it will show
them no mercy.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0663_000
text:
When it gets excited, it vents sparks from the
gaps between its feathers. These unburnable
feathers are used as a fireproof material.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0664_000
text:
This Pokémon scatters poisonous powder
to repel enemies. It will eat different plants
depending on where it lives.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0665_000
text:
Spewpa doesn’t live in a fixed location. It roams
where it pleases across the fields and mountains,
building up the energy it needs to evolve.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0666_000
text:
This Pokémon was born in frigid lands. It scatters
colorful, toxic scales from its wings during battle.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0666_001
text:
This Pokémon was born in a snowy land.
It scatters colorful, toxic scales from its wings
during battle.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0666_002
text:
This Pokémon was born in a land of severe cold.
It scatters colorful, toxic scales from its wings
during battle.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0666_003
text:
This Pokémon was born in a land of vast space.
It scatters colorful, toxic scales from its wings
during battle.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0666_004
text:
This Pokémon was born in a verdant land.
It scatters colorful, toxic scales from its wings
during battle.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0666_005
text:
This Pokémon was born in a land with distinct
seasons. It scatters colorful, toxic scales from its
wings during battle.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0666_006
text:
This Pokémon was born in a land where flowers
bloom. It scatters colorful, toxic scales from its
wings during battle.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0666_007
text:
This Pokémon was born in a sun-drenched land.
It scatters colorful, toxic scales from its wings
during battle.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0666_008
text:
This Pokémon was born in a land with ocean
breezes. It scatters colorful, toxic scales from its
wings during battle.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0666_009
text:
This Pokémon was born in a place with many
islands. It scatters colorful, toxic scales from its
wings during battle.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0666_010
text:
This Pokémon was born in a land with little rain.
It scatters colorful, toxic scales from its wings
during battle.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0666_011
text:
This Pokémon was born in a parched land.
It scatters colorful, toxic scales from its wings
during battle.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0666_012
text:
This Pokémon was born in a land where large
rivers flow. It scatters colorful, toxic scales from
its wings during battle.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0666_013
text:
This Pokémon was born in a land with intense
rainfall. It scatters colorful, toxic scales from its
wings during battle.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0666_014
text:
This Pokémon was born in a land with a tropical
climate. It scatters colorful, toxic scales from its
wings during battle.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0666_015
text:
This Pokémon was born in a land bathed in light.
It scatters colorful, toxic scales from its wings
during battle.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0666_016
text:
This Pokémon was born in a land of perpetual
summer. It scatters colorful, toxic scales from its
wings during battle.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0666_017
text:
This Pokémon was born in a land of tropical rain
forests. It scatters colorful, toxic scales from its
wings during battle.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0666_018
text:
This Pokémon was born in a mysterious land.
It scatters colorful, toxic scales from its wings
during battle.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0666_019
text:
This Pokémon was born in a special land.
It scatters colorful, toxic scales from its wings
during battle.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0667_000
text:
The more a Litleo trains its body and spirit by
battling mighty enemies, the hotter its mane
will grow.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0668_000
text:
The mane of a male Pyroar heats up to over
3,600 degrees Fahrenheit during battle. Merely
approaching it will cause severe burns.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0669_000
text:
This Flabébé rides a red flower. Immediately
after birth, this Pokémon begins flying around in
search of a flower it likes.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0669_001
text:
It unleashes a variety of moves by drawing forth
the power hidden within flowers. This Pokémon is
particularly fond of yellow flowers.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0669_002
text:
It receives strength from flowers and gives them
some of its energy in return. This Pokémon likes
orange flowers best of all.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0669_003
text:
This Pokémon likes blue flowers best of all.
It floats upward using the power emanating from
its flower and bobs along lightly through the air.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0669_004
text:
When evening falls, it searches out a place
blooming with flowers of the same white color
as itself, and then it goes to sleep.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0670_000
text:
This Pokémon uses red wavelengths of light to
pour its own energy into flowers and draw forth
their latent potential.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0670_001
text:
Floette can draw forth the latent capabilities of
Grass-type Pokémon. It syncs with yellow flowers.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0670_002
text:
This Pokémon cannot use moves on its own.
When it syncs with flowers, it becomes able
to use Grass-type moves.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0670_003
text:
It exchanges power with flowers via wavelengths
of visible light. This form of Floette can sync with
the wavelength that produces the color blue.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0670_004
text:
If it finds someone messing up a flower bed,
it will attack them without mercy. This Floette
takes particularly good care of white flowers.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0671_000
text:
They say that flower gardens created by Florges
are constantly showered with a power that can
heal both body and spirit.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0671_001
text:
This Pokémon battles by drawing forth the power
of yellow flowers. It ruthlessly punishes anyone
who tramples on flowering plants.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0671_002
text:
In times long past, castle governors would
lovingly raise Florges to care for their castles’
exquisite gardens.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0671_003
text:
Blue pigments were tremendously expensive
in the past, so paintings of blue Florges are
highly valuable.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0671_004
text:
A Florges adorned with white flowers can sync
with the wavelengths of various colors to draw
forth their power.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0672_000
text:
As long as it has sunlight and water, Skiddo can
make energy with the leaves on its body, allowing
it to live on rocky mountains barren of food.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0673_000
text:
These Pokémon live in herds in mountainous
places. The victor in their contests of clashing
horns will become the leader of the herd.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0677_000
text:
Behind an Espurr’s expressionless face is a frantic
struggle to contain psychic power.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0678_000
text:
If Meowstic continuously emits its powerful
psychic energy, it will damage its own body.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0678_001
text:
When they sense danger, they exert their psychic
power at its maximum output. They have no
regard for their opponents.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0686_000
text:
Being upside-down improves its blood flow and
clears its mind, causing the power of its psychic
moves to increase dramatically.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0687_000
text:
It flashes the luminescent spots on its body
to hypnotize its opponents, gaining total
control over them.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0690_000
text:
This Pokémon is a poor swimmer. If it’s caught in
a fierce storm, it will sometimes get washed far
away and become unable to return to its home.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0691_000
text:
Since Finizen is the better swimmer, Dragalge
will approach it under the cover of seaweed,
then immobilize it with a poisonous attack.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0692_000
text:
Clauncher’s claws will regrow if they fall off.
The meat inside the claws is edible, but it has a
distinct flavor that doesn’t appeal to all tastes.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0693_000
text:
The cannonballs of seawater that Clawitzer
launches from its claw are powerful enough to
punch through tanker hulls.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0700_000
text:
Sylveon cuts an elegant figure as it dances lightly
around, feelers fluttering, but its piercing moves
aim straight for its opponents’ weak spots.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0701_000
text:
Hawlucha live quietly without flocking together.
They fight constantly with their natural enemies:
noisy groups of Primeape.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0702_000
text:
Dedenne emit electrical waves from the whiskers
on their cheeks to communicate with each other.
When low on electricity, they curl up and sleep.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0703_000
text:
Born from the high temperatures and pressures
deep underground, it defends itself by firing
beams from the jewel part of its body.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0704_000
text:
Goomy’s horns are excellent sensory organs that
cover all five of Goomy’s senses. Goomy picks
up on danger from the movement of the air.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0705_000
text:
When Sliggoo senses danger, the mucus coating
its entire body becomes more concentrated—
it’ll dissolve anything.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0706_000
text:
This Pokémon is uncontrollable when enraged.
It rampages on and on, lashing its tail with
enough power to send a dump truck flying.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0707_000
text:
In the past, noble families entrusted their vault
keys to a Klefki. They passed the Klefki down
through the generations, taking good care of it.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0708_000
text:
This Pokémon came to be when the spirit of a
deceased child possessed a tree stump. It now
wanders the forest searching for friends.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0709_000
text:
Trevenant is very kind to Pokémon living in the
forest. It doesn’t even care if these Pokémon
take up residence in the greenery on its head.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0712_000
text:
Bergmite protects itself by coating its body in ice
formed by frigid air of −148 degrees Fahrenheit.
It fights with Frigibax whenever they meet.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0713_000
text:
This Pokémon uses its massive icy body to flatten
anything that gets in its way. When it’s floating
out on the ocean, it looks exactly like drift ice.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0714_000
text:
Noibat can change the frequency of its sound
waves at will, and it generates ultrasonic waves of
up to 200,000 hertz.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0715_000
text:
In the dark, even Hydreigon are terrified of this
Pokémon. But in the light, Noivern is the one that
avoids battle.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0722_000
text:
It feels relaxed in tight, dark places and has been
known to nestle into its Trainer’s bag or the front
of their jacket.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0723_000
text:
It throws sharp feathers called blade quills at
enemies or prey. It seldom misses.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0724_000
text:
It nocks its arrow quills and looses them at
opponents. When it needs to hit, it pulls the
vines on its hood to narrow its view and focus.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0725_000
text:
While grooming itself, it builds up fur inside its
stomach. It sets the fur alight and spews fiery
attacks, which change based on how it coughs.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0726_000
text:
Torracat will let its Trainer coddle it once they’ve
grown close, but it’s a powerful, sharp-clawed
Pokémon, so its Trainer gets covered in scratches.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0727_000
text:
After hurling ferocious punches and flinging
furious kicks, it finishes opponents off by spewing
fire from around its navel.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0728_000
text:
The balloons it inflates with its nose grow larger
and larger as it practices day by day.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0729_000
text:
It cares deeply for its companions. When its
Trainer is feeling down, it performs a cheery
dance to try to help.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0730_000
text:
Also known as a songstress, it is a sight to
behold on moonlit nights when it sings in
front of the colony it leads.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0731_000
text:
Pikipek has strong muscles in its neck, so it won’t
hurt itself even if it violently shakes its head.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0732_000
text:
When it encounters foes, it launches the many
seeds stored in its beak in a radial burst.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0733_000
text:
Pairs of Toucannon are considered symbols of
companionship, as these Pokémon will raise the
temperature of their beaks to warm each other.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0734_000
text:
It spends its waking hours searching endlessly for
food. When Yungoos is hungry, its ferocity gains
a certain edge.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0735_000
text:
Gumshoos specializes in relentlessly tracking
down prey. The simple-minded Skwovet doesn’t
seem to provide Gumshoos enough challenge.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0736_000
text:
It spits sticky threads and winds them around
branches, then swings nimbly from tree to tree
in a pendulum-like motion.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0737_000
text:
As it digests fallen leaves, it generates and stores
electricity, which it can discharge from the tips of
its jaws.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0738_000
text:
When carrying a Charjabug, Vikavolt can receive
electricity from it and then rapidly fire powerful
electromagnetic beams from its large jaws.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0739_000
text:
If it loses its pincers, they’ll quickly regrow.
The pincers are popular ingredients in paella
since their shells produce a tasty soup stock.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0740_000
text:
Though its punches are powerful, this Pokémon’s
movements are sluggish. It blows icy bubbles
from its mouth to immobilize its opponents.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0741_000
text:
This form of Oricorio has sipped red nectar.
It whips up blazing flames as it moves to the
steps of its passionate dance.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0741_001
text:
The energetic, cheerful dance of these Oricorio
is popular with children, but the Oricorio
themselves are hard to find in Paldea.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0741_002
text:
This form of Oricorio has sipped pink nectar.
It elevates its mind with the gentle steps of its
dance, then unleashes its psychic energy.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0741_003
text:
The elegant, attractive dance of these Oricorio is
popular with adults, but the Oricorio themselves
are hard to find in Paldea.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0742_000
text:
Cutiefly sucks up pollen and nectar with its long
proboscis. It stores any pollen it doesn’t finish
eating in its fur.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0743_000
text:
Pollen puffs created by skilled Ribombee can
relieve fatigue, making the puffs a popular
commodity.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0744_000
text:
This Pokémon travels in a pack with others until
it grows up. When its mood turns sour, it starts
striking the ground with the rocks on its neck.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0745_000
text:
It has a calm and collected demeanor. It swiftly
closes in on its prey, then slices them with the
rocks in its mane.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0745_001
text:
This Lycanroc has an extremely vicious
temperament. It will happily sustain injuries
for the sake of taking down its opponent.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0745_002
text:
These Pokémon have both calm and ferocious
qualities. It’s said that this form of Lycanroc is
the most troublesome to raise.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0747_000
text:
It has excellent regenerative capabilities. Legs
that a Mareanie has lost have a very bitter,
astringent flavor—they’re not suitable as food.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0748_000
text:
Toxapex gets into fierce battles with Bruxish over
areas where warm ocean currents flow, but the
odds are always against it.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0749_000
text:
Though a slow walker, Mudbray is plenty strong.
Its pace doesn’t change even when it’s loaded
with 50 times its own body weight.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0750_000
text:
Its legs are fortified with mud and harder than
stone, and they can reduce a large truck to scrap
with one kick.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0751_000
text:
