It supports the water bubble that envelops its
head with three of its legs. Sometimes it secretly
swaps which legs are holding up the bubble.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0752_000
text:
It launches sticky water bubbles. Foes who lose
consciousness while trapped inside these bubbles
will get torn apart by Araquanid’s gnashing jaws.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0753_000
text:
Many Trainers give their Fomantis their own
flowerpots so they can sunbathe in peace
and quiet.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0754_000
text:
A lot of time and effort is required to maintain
the vivid colors of its petals. This Pokémon puts
its Trainer’s attentiveness to the test.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0757_000
text:
Only female Salandit can produce gas laden
with pheromones. Males entranced by this gas
will do whatever the females tell them.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0758_000
text:
When two Salazzle meet, they will use their
pheromone gas to fight over the males in each
other’s group.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0761_000
text:
A Greedent drawn in by the sweet scent of these
Pokémon will tuck the Bounsweet in among the
berries in its tail and carry them all away.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0762_000
text:
Steenee bounces energetically through forests.
If the rind that peels off its body is pulverized,
it can be used to treat stomach pains.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0763_000
text:
This Pokémon launches fierce yet elegant kicks
with its long, slender legs. It views Quaquaval as
its rival.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0764_000
text:
It prefers areas with lots of flowers. A Comfey
adorned with flowers is a happy Comfey, and the
flowers gain healing effects.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0765_000
text:
This Pokémon lives quietly in the depths of the
forest. The purple, cape-like fur gets longer and
longer as Oranguru ages.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0766_000
text:
The boss chooses 10 members of the group to
go out hunting. The hunting party will evenly split
the food they find with the rest of the group.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0769_000
text:
It flings sand into the eyes of its prey and tries to
close in on them while they’re blinded, but since
Sandygast is so slow, the prey tends to escape.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0770_000
text:
From the hollows in its arms, it fires the bones
of its victims, which are all dried up after being
drained of their vitality.

It will react when touched or called to, but it’s

consciousness.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0775_000
text:
A potent anesthetic can be made by diluting
Komala’s drool. This anesthetic was used for
surgeries in the past.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0778_000
text:
Mimikyu was only recently identified as a
Pokémon. Previously, people thought it was
just a ghost wearing a cloth.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0778_001
text:
It has taken damage and can no longer hold the
head of its cloth disguise upright. For as long as
it lives, Mimikyu will never forget its attacker.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0779_000
text:
When sunlight reflects on the ripples created by
a Bruxish grinding its teeth, the water all around
sparkles brilliantly.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0782_000
text:
They communicate with their allies using the
sounds their scales make when struck. A group
of these Pokémon causes quite a racket.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0783_000
text:
It fires itself up by striking its scales with force as
it dances. Its roar is a battle cry.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0784_000
text:
It bashes its scales to test its opponents’ mettle.
The sound of struck Kommo-o scales frightens
weaker foes and sends them running.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0810_000
text:
As Grookey strikes everything in sight with its
stick, it has more and more fun, and its rhythm
becomes livelier.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0811_000
text:
It becomes intensely focused while it drums out
vigorous beats—so much so that sometimes it
won’t listen to its Trainer’s commands.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0812_000
text:
When one Rillaboom challenges another who
leads a troop, a drumming battle commences.
The victor becomes the troop’s new boss.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0813_000
text:
Fire energy gathers in the pads of its feet,
raising their temperature. Once hot, Scorbunny’s
footpads can deal heavy damage to opponents.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0814_000
text:
While it prides itself on its varied kicking moves,
it can also deliver powerful headbutts once its
flames have heated up its forehead.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0815_000
text:
Using a ball that it made out of flames,
Cinderace blinds its opponents and
keeps them at bay.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0816_000
text:
It’s a very cautious Pokémon. When it has
no choice but to battle, it hides itself before
attacking.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0817_000
text:
Highly intelligent but also very lazy, it defends its
home by laying traps.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0818_000
text:
It may present itself as being well-mannered,
but deep down, it still has a lazy side. It will
slack off when its Trainer isn’t looking.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0819_000
text:
No matter how much it stuffs its belly with food,
it is always anxious about getting hungry again.
So, it stashes berries in its cheeks and tail.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0820_000
text:
This Pokémon makes off with heaps of fallen
berries by wrapping them in its tail, which is
roughly twice the length of its body.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0821_000
text:
The females are fussier than the males. If another
creature dirties a female Rookidee’s wings, it’ll
peck the offender relentlessly in a burning rage.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0822_000
text:
This intelligent Pokémon will quickly learn how to
use any tool it can hold in its beak or its talons.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0823_000
text:
Although its wings have partly turned to steel and
become heavy as a result, this Pokémon flies
through the skies with ease.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0833_000
text:
A popular game among children is to lift up sticks
that Chewtle have bitten onto to see whose
Chewtle can hang on the longest.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0834_000
text:
Drednaw lurks along the shoreline. When prey
come to drink water, Drednaw stretches its neck
out and chomps down on them.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0837_000
text:
Chunks of the surface of this Pokémon’s body
that have grown old and flaked off have long
been used for fuel as an alternative to coal.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0838_000
text:
Due to the coal tar created inside it, the heap of
coal on Carkol’s back never falls apart, even
when the Pokémon rolls around at high speeds.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0839_000
text:
It’s gentle usually but fearsome when angered.
With a body that burns at over 2,700 degrees
Fahrenheit, it crushes foes and turns them to ash.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0840_000
text:
Applin lives inside an apple. When an Applin is
separated from its apple, its body loses moisture
and the Pokémon grows weak.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0841_000
text:
It uses its own body fluid to repair its apple.
Strong Flapple that have won many battles have
apples that are clay colored all over.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0842_000
text:
When some Lechonk come along to lick the
sweet nectar on Appletun’s back, Appletun will
spew sticky nectar at them to drive them away.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0843_000
text:
Silicobra’s large nostrils are specialized for
spraying sand, so this Pokémon is not very good
at telling apart different smells.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0844_000
text:
The sand it spews contains sharp, pointy gravel,
which is actually just sand that Sandaconda’s
saliva has hardened into irregular shapes.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0845_000
text:
It’s an incredibly poor learner because it uses the
bare minimum amount of energy for its brain.
It focuses on battling instead.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0845_001
text:
Cramorant takes advantage of Arrokuda’s frantic
thrashing to help spit Arrokuda out at high speed.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0845_002
text:
With a Pikachu stuck in its throat, Cramorant
can use Pikachu’s prickling electricity to give
its opponents a shock.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0846_000
text:
It takes down prey by charging into them with
its hard, pointed jaw. But Arrokuda’s eyesight is
poor, so this tactic has a low success rate.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0847_000
text:
It swims at speeds of over 100 knots and battles
fiercely with pods of Finizen over prey.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0848_000
text:
This selfish, attention-seeking Pokémon stores
poison and electricity in two different sacs inside
its body.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0849_000
text:
The jolts of electricity it launches by violently
strumming the protrusions on its chest easily
exceed 15,000 volts.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0849_001
text:
As it gulps down stagnant water and generates
electricity in its body, a sound like a rhythm
played by a bass guitar reverberates all around.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0854_000
text:
Sinistea gets into your body when you drink it,
and then it steals your vitality from within. It also
tastes awful.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0854_001
text:
This Sinistea lives in an antique teacup.
As valuable as this Pokémon is, its awful taste
remains unchanged.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0855_000
text:
These Pokémon multiply by creeping into teapots
and pouring themselves into leftover tea.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0855_001
text:
Though risky to drink, this Pokémon’s tea tastes
delicious. Gourmets who have no fear of danger
drink Polteageist tea day after day.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0856_000
text:
It senses the feelings of other living creatures.
Be careful not to expose it to strong emotions
for too long, or it will end up exhausted.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0857_000
text:
The moment this Pokémon finds someone who’s
emitting strong emotions, it will pummel them
senseless with its braids to silence them.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0858_000
text:
Beware of forests that show no signs of living
creatures within. You may have wandered into
Hatterene’s territory.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0859_000
text:
They live in groups, pestering and playing pranks
on each other to polish their troublemaking skills.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0860_000
text:
This Pokémon absorbs negative emotions and
turns them into energy. It’s popular with people
who tend to think gloomy thoughts.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0861_000
text:
It lives deep within the forest. Even after evolving
into this splendid form, it hasn’t given up on its
petty misdeeds and pranks.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0868_000
text:
When attacked, it tackles its foe and covers
them in cream. With its foe either blinded or
astonished by deliciousness, Milcery flees.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0869_000
text:
Alcremie that have been cherished produce
exquisite cream, so Trainers always raise them
lovingly.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0869_001
text:
When attacked, it strikes back by throwing cream
accented with sweet and tart flavors.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0869_002
text:
When attacked, it strikes back by throwing cream
accented with an aromatic flavor.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0869_003
text:
When attacked, it strikes back by throwing cream
accented with a refreshing flavor.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0869_004
text:
When attacked, it strikes back by throwing cream
accented with a sour flavor.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0869_005
text:
When attacked, it strikes back by throwing cream
accented with a salty flavor.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0869_006
text:
When attacked, it strikes back by throwing cream
accented with a mix of flavors.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0869_007
text:
When attacked, it strikes back by throwing cream
accented with a bitter flavor.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0869_008
text:
When attacked, it strikes back by throwing cream
accented with complex flavors.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0870_000
text:
The leader, known as the brass, uses its
extendible horn to issue orders to the others
when it’s time to change formation.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0871_000
text:
This Pokémon is so timid that even brushing
against seaweed will make it discharge electricity
in surprise. Its lips do not conduct electricity.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0872_000
text:
Within its internal organs, Snom amplifies the
frigid air it gets from eating snow and then uses
this amplified air to create icicle-like spikes.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0873_000
text:
It causes blizzards as it flies around with its huge,
chill-emanating wings. Clean meltwater is its
favorite thing to drink.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0874_000
text:
This Pokémon spends its life gazing at the setting
sun. It strides leisurely across grassy plains on
legs of rock that weigh over 400 pounds each.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0875_000
text:
If you lick the ice covering its face, you’ll find it
has a faintly salty taste. This species rode here on
ocean currents from a cold, faraway land.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0875_001
text:
Contrary to its looks, Eiscue is a poor swimmer.
It creates ice balls at the tip of its single hair to
lure prey in and fish them up.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0876_000
text:
This Pokémon never leaves its Trainer’s side.
It predicts their actions with its psychic power
and takes care of their day-to-day needs.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0876_001
text:
In search of happy feelings—such as joy and
gratitude—Indeedee bustles around, taking
diligent care of people and other Pokémon.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0877_000
text:
It has a small stomach. If it isn’t constantly eating
the seeds it keeps in its pockets, it will get hungry
immediately.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0877_001
text:
Hunger has disrupted this Pokémon’s hormonal
balance. The Electric-type energy stored in its
cheek sacs has turned into Dark-type energy.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0878_000
text:
Cufant can lift loads weighing five tons. In the
mornings, it heads into caves with its herd, in
search of the ore on which these Pokémon feed.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0879_000
text:
Copperajah are prideful, cantankerous Pokémon.
Specimens with vibrant green skin command the
respect of others of their kind.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0884_000
text:
Its metal body is durable but prone to
retaining heat. It vents this heat from the
slits in its tail.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0885_000
text:
It has a habit of biting at Clauncher even though
it doesn’t feed on them. This is said to be
vestigial behavior from when Dreepy was alive.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0886_000
text:
This Pokémon stores up energy in its lungs, then
shoots it out. It takes care of Dreepy and battles
alongside them until they’re all grown up.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0887_000
text:
The fastest Dragapult of the group is always
surrounded by Dreepy that want to fly at
sonic speed.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0902_000
text:
It can jump with incredible power. Parts of its
body are tinged red by the rage of its fallen
friends.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0902_001
text:
It can afflict a target with terrifying illusions that
are under its control. The deeper the sadness in
its friends’ souls, the paler Basculegion becomes.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0906_000
text:
The sweet scent its body gives off mesmerizes
those around it. The scent grows stronger when
this Pokémon is in the sun.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0907_000
text:
The hardness of Floragato’s fur depends on the
Pokémon’s mood. When Floragato is prepared to
battle, its fur becomes pointed and needle sharp.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0908_000
text:
With skillful misdirection, it rigs foes with pollen-
packed flower bombs. Meowscarada sets off the
bombs before its foes realize what’s going on.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0909_000
text:
Its flame sac is small, so energy is always leaking
out. This energy is released from the dent atop
Fuecoco’s head and flickers to and fro.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0910_000
text:
The valve in Crocalor’s flame sac is closely
connected to its vocal cords. This Pokémon utters
a guttural cry as it spews flames every which way.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0911_000
text:
Skeledirge’s gentle singing soothes the souls of
all that hear it. It burns its enemies to a crisp with
flames of over 5,400 degrees Fahrenheit.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0912_000
text:
Its strong legs let it easily swim around in even
fast-flowing rivers. It likes to keep things tidy and
is prone to overthinking things.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0913_000
text:
The hardworking Quaxwell observes people and
Pokémon from various regions and incorporates
their movements into its own dance routines.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0914_000
text:
Dancing in ways that evoke far-away places, this
Pokémon mesmerizes all that see it. Flourishes of
its decorative water feathers slice into its foes.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0915_000
text:
This Pokémon spurns all but the finest of foods.
Its body gives off an herblike scent that bug
Pokémon detest.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0916_000
text:
It entrances female Pokémon with the sweet,
alluring scent that wafts from all over its body.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0916_001
text:
This is a meticulous Pokémon that likes to keep
things tidy. It shrouds itself in a floral aroma that
soothes the Pokémon around it.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0917_000
text:
The thread it secretes from its rear is as strong as
wire. The secret behind the thread’s strength is
the topic of ongoing research.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0918_000
text:
Spidops covers its territory in tough, sticky
threads to set up traps for intruders.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0919_000
text:
It’s highly skilled at a fighting style in which it
uses its jumping capabilities to dodge incoming
attacks while also dealing damage to opponents.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0920_000
text:
It uses its normally folded third set of legs when
in Showdown Mode. This places a huge burden
on its body, so it can’t stay in this mode for long.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0921_000
text:
The pads of its paws are electricity-discharging
organs. Pawmi fires electricity from its forepaws
while standing unsteadily on its hind legs.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0922_000
text:
Pawmo uses a unique fighting technique in which
it uses its forepaws to strike foes and zap them
with electricity from its paw pads simultaneously.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0923_000
text:
Pawmot’s fluffy fur acts as a battery. It can store
the same amount of electricity as an electric car.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0924_000
text:
The pair sticks together no matter what. They
split any food they find exactly in half and then
eat it together.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0925_000
text:
The little one just appeared one day. They all
live together like a family, but the relationship
between the three is still unclear.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0925_001
text:
The larger pair protects the little ones during
battles. When facing strong opponents, the
whole group will join the fight.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0926_000
text:
The yeast in Fidough’s breath is useful for
cooking, so this Pokémon has been protected
by people since long ago.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0927_000
text:
The surface of this Pokémon’s skin hardens when
exposed to intense heat, and its body has an
appetizing aroma.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0928_000
text:
This Pokémon converts nutrients into oil, which it
stores in the fruit on its head. It can easily go a
whole week without eating or drinking.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0929_000
text:
It basks in the sun to its heart’s content until the
fruits on its head ripen. After that, Dolliv departs
from human settlements and goes on a journey.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0930_000
text:
This Pokémon drives back enemies by launching
its rich, aromatic oil at them with enough force to
smash a boulder.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0931_000
text:
Green-feathered flocks hold the most sway.
When they’re out searching for food in the
mornings and evenings, it gets very noisy.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0931_001
text:
Blue-feathered Squawkabilly view their green-
feathered counterparts as rivals, since the latter
make up the largest, most powerful groups.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0931_002
text:
The yellow Squawkabilly are especially fierce.
They’ve even been known to drive other bird
Pokémon out of town.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0931_003
text:
Though these Squawkabilly are the fewest in
number, they have no trouble living in towns
since they blend in with the white buildings.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0932_000
text:
The ground scrapes its body as it travels, causing
it to leave salt behind. Salt is constantly being
created and replenished inside Nacli’s body.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0933_000
text:
It compresses rock salt inside its body and shoots
out hardened salt pellets with enough force to
perforate an iron sheet.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0934_000
text:
Many Pokémon gather around Garganacl, hoping
to lick at its mineral-rich salt.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0935_000
text:
Its firepower increases when it fights, reaching
over 1,800 degrees Fahrenheit. It likes berries
that are rich in fat.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0936_000
text:
This Pokémon clads itself in armor that has been
fortified by psychic and fire energy, and it shoots
blazing fireballs.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0937_000
text:
An old set of armor steeped in grudges caused
this Pokémon’s evolution. Ceruledge cuts its
enemies to pieces without mercy.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0938_000
text:
It floats using the electricity stored in its body.
When thunderclouds are around, Tadbulb will
float higher off the ground.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0939_000
text:
What appear to be eyeballs are actually organs
for discharging the electricity generated by
Bellibolt’s belly-button dynamo.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0940_000
text:
These Pokémon make their nests on coastal cliffs.
The nests have a strange, crackling texture, and
they’re a popular delicacy.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0941_000
text:
It uses its throat sac to store electricity generated
by its wings. There’s hardly any oil in its feathers,
so it is a poor swimmer.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0942_000
text:
Its well-developed jaw and fangs are strong
enough to crunch through boulders, and its thick
fat makes for an excellent defense.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0943_000
text:
Mabosstiff loves playing with children. Though
usually gentle, it takes on an intimidating look
when protecting its family.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0944_000
text:
To keep enemies away from its territory, it paints
markings around its nest using a poisonous liquid
that has an acrid odor.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0945_000
text:
Each Grafaiai paints its own individual pattern,
and it will paint that same pattern over and over
again throughout its life.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0946_000
text:
Not even Bramblin knows where it is headed as
it tumbles across the wilderness, blown by the
wind. It loathes getting wet.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0947_000
text:
Brambleghast wanders around arid regions.
On rare occasions, mass outbreaks of these
Pokémon will bury an entire town.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0948_000
text:
Though it looks like Tentacool, Toedscool is a
completely different species. Its legs may be thin,
but it can run at a speed of 30 mph.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0949_000
text:
It coils its 10 tentacles around prey and sucks out
their nutrients, causing the prey pain. The folds
along the rim of its head are a popular delicacy.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0950_000
text:
This Pokémon lives on sheer cliffs. It sidesteps
opponents’ attacks, then lunges for their weak
spots with its claws.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0951_000
text:
Traditional Paldean dishes can be extremely spicy
because they include the shed front teeth of
Capsakid among their ingredients.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0952_000
text:
The green head has turned vicious due to the
spicy chemicals stimulating its brain. Once it goes
on a rampage, there is no stopping it.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0953_000
text:
It rolls its mud ball around while the energy it
needs for evolution matures. Eventually the time
comes for it to evolve.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0954_000
text:
An infant sleeps inside the ball. Rabsca rolls
the ball soothingly with its legs to ensure the
infant sleeps comfortably.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0955_000
text:
It spends its time running around wastelands.
If anyone steals its beloved berries, it will chase
them down and exact its revenge.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0956_000
text:
It emits psychic power from the gaps between its
multicolored frills and sprints at speeds greater
than 120 mph.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0957_000
text:
This Pokémon pounds iron scraps together to
make a hammer. It will remake the hammer again
and again until it’s satisfied with the result.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0958_000
text:
These Pokémon make their homes in piles of
scrap metal. They test the strength of each
other’s hammers by smashing them together.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0959_000
text:
The hammer tops 220 pounds, yet it gets swung
around easily by Tinkaton as it steals whatever it
pleases and carries its plunder back home.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0960_000
text:
Though it looks like Diglett, Wiglett is an entirely
different species. The resemblance seems to be a
coincidental result of environmental adaptation.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0961_000
text:
A variety of fish Pokémon, Wugtrio was once
considered to be a regional form of Dugtrio.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0962_000
text:
Bombirdier uses the apron on its chest to bundle
up food, which it carries back to its nest. It enjoys
dropping things that make loud noises.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0963_000
text:
Its water ring is made from seawater mixed with
a sticky fluid that Finizen secretes from
its blowhole.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0964_000
text:
Its physical capabilities are no different than
a Finizen’s, but when its allies are in danger,
it transforms and powers itself up.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0964_001
text:
This hero of the ocean swims at a speed of 50
knots and saves drowning people and Pokémon.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0965_000
text:
The steel section is Varoom’s actual body.
This Pokémon clings to rocks and converts the
minerals within into energy to fuel its activities.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0966_000
text:
Revavroom viciously threatens others with the
sound of its exhaust. It sticks its tongue out from
its cylindrical mouth and sprays toxic fluids.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0967_000
text:
It can sprint at over 70 mph while carrying a
human. The rider’s body heat warms Cyclizar’s
back and lifts the Pokémon’s spirit.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0968_000
text:
This Pokémon lives in arid deserts. It maintains its
metal body by consuming iron from the soil.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0969_000
text:
Glimmet’s toxic mineral crystals look just like
flower petals. This Pokémon scatters poisonous
powder like pollen to protect itself.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0970_000
text:
Glimmora’s petals are made of crystallized
poison energy. It has recently become evident
that these petals resemble Tera Jewels.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0971_000
text:
This friendly Pokémon doesn’t like being alone.
Pay it even the slightest bit of attention, and it
will follow you forever.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0972_000
text:
A lovingly mourned Pokémon was reborn as
Houndstone. It doesn’t like anyone touching
the protuberance atop its head.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0973_000
text:
Thanks to a behavior of theirs known as
“synchronizing,” an entire flock of these Pokémon
can attack simultaneously in perfect harmony.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0974_000
text:
It lives in frigid regions in pods of five or so
individuals. It loves the minerals found in snow
and ice.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0975_000
text:
Ice energy builds up in the horn on its upper jaw,
causing the horn to reach cryogenic temperatures
that freeze its surroundings.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0976_000
text:
Veluza has excellent regenerative capabilities.
It sheds spare flesh from its body to boost its
agility, then charges at its prey.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0977_000
text:
It treats Tatsugiri like its boss and follows it
loyally. Though powerful, Dondozo is apparently
not very smart.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0978_000
text:
Tatsugiri is an extremely cunning Pokémon.
It feigns weakness to lure in prey, then orders
its partner to attack.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0978_001
text:
This Pokémon tricks its opponents by playing
dead. It is small and weak, but it uses its smarts
to survive.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0978_002
text:
It’s one of the most intelligent dragon Pokémon.
It camouflages itself by inflating its throat sac.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0979_000
text:
It imbues its fists with the power of the rage that
it kept hidden in its heart. Opponents struck by
these imbued fists will be shattered to their core.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0980_000
text:
It lives at the bottom of ponds and swamps.
It will carry Wooper on its back and ferry them
across water from one shore to the other.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0981_000
text:
The hardened head from the tail protects the
head of the main body as Farigiraf whips its long
neck around to headbutt enemies.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0982_000
text:
It drives enemies out of its nest by sucking in
enough air to fill its long, narrow lungs, then
releasing the air in an intense blast.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0982_001
text:
A recent study uncovered that the number
of segments a Dudunsparce’s body has is
determined by the Pokémon’s genes.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0983_000
text:
Though it commands a massive army in battle,
it’s not skilled at devising complex strategies.
It just uses brute strength to keep pushing.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0984_000
text:
This creature resembles a mysterious Pokémon
that, according to a paranormal magazine, has
lived since ancient times.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0985_000
text:
It resembles a mysterious Pokémon described
in a paranormal magazine as a Jigglypuff from
one billion years ago.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0986_000
text:
It bears a slight resemblance to a Pokémon
described in a dubious magazine as a cross
between a dinosaur and a mushroom.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0987_000
text:
It has similar features to a ghostly pterosaur that
was covered in a paranormal magazine, but the
two have little else in common.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0988_000
text:
This Pokémon somewhat resembles an ancient
form of Volcarona that was introduced in a
dubious magazine.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0989_000
text:
It slightly resembles a Magneton that lived for
10,000 years and was featured in an article in
a paranormal magazine.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0990_000
text:
Sightings of this Pokémon have occurred in recent
years. It resembles a mysterious object described
in an old expedition journal.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0991_000
text:
It resembles a mysterious object mentioned in an
old book. There are only two reported sightings
of this Pokémon.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0992_000
text:
This Pokémon shares many similarities with
Iron Hands, an object mentioned in a certain
expedition journal.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0993_000
text:
It’s possible that Iron Jugulis, an object described
in an old book, may actually be this Pokémon.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0994_000
text:
No records exist of this species being caught.
Data is lacking, but the Pokémon’s traits match
up with an object described in an old book.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0995_000
text:
Some of its notable features match those of an
object named within a certain expedition journal
as Iron Thorns.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0996_000
text:
This Pokémon lives in forests and craggy areas.
Using the power of its dorsal fin, it cools the
inside of its nest like a refrigerator.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0997_000
text:
It attacks with the blade of its frozen dorsal fin
by doing a front flip in the air. Arctibax’s strong
back and legs allow it to pull off this technique.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0998_000
text:
It launches itself into battle by flipping upside
down and spewing frigid air from its mouth.
It finishes opponents off with its dorsal blade.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0999_000
text:
It lives inside an old treasure chest. Sometimes it
gets left in shop corners since no one realizes
it’s actually a Pokémon.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0999_001
text:
It wanders around, carrying an old coin on its
back. It survives by draining the life-force from
humans who try to pick up its coin.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_1000_000
text:
It has a sturdy body made up of stacked coins.
Gholdengo overwhelms its enemies by firing coin
after coin at them in quick succession.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_1001_000
text:
It drains the life-force from vegetation, causing
nearby forests to instantly wither and fields to
turn barren.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_1002_000
text:
The hatred of those who perished by the sword
long ago has clad itself in snow and become
a Pokémon.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_1003_000
text:
It slowly brings its exceedingly heavy head down
upon the ground, splitting the earth open with
huge fissures that run over 160 feet deep.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_1004_000
text:
The envy accumulated within curved beads that
sparked multiple conflicts has clad itself in fire
and become a Pokémon.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_1005_000
text:
According to an article in a dubious magazine,
this Pokémon has some connection to a
phenomenon that occurs in a certain region.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_1006_000
text:
It’s possible that this is the object listed as
Iron Valiant in a certain expedition journal.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_1007_000
text:
This Pokémon resembles Cyclizar, but it is far
burlier and more ferocious. Nothing is known
about its ecology or other features.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_1008_000
text:
This seems to be the Iron Serpent mentioned in
an old book. The Iron Serpent is said to have
turned the land to ash with its lightning.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_1009_000
text:
It resembles an illustration published in a
paranormal magazine, said to be a depiction
of a super-ancient Suicune.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_1010_000
text:
According to the few eyewitness accounts that
exist, it used its shining blades to julienne large
trees and boulders.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0901_001
text:
This special Ursaluna can see in the dark with
its left eye and protects itself with mud that is
as hard as iron.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_1011_000
text:
The head sticking out belongs to the fore-wyrm,
while the tail belongs to the core-wyrm. The two
share one apple and help each other out.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_1012_000
text:
Poltchageist looks like a regional form of
Sinistea, but it was recently discovered that
the two Pokémon are entirely unrelated.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_1012_001
text:
It has taken up residence in a very expensive
tea caddy. It takes an expert to distinguish the
expensive tea caddies from the cheap ones.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_1013_000
text:
It prefers cool, dark places, such as the back of a
shelf or the space beneath a home’s floorboards.
It wanders in search of prey after sunset.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_1013_001
text:
The more stirring it does with the tea whisk on its
head, the more energy it builds up. It does this to
prepare for battle.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_1014_000
text:
Okidogi is a ruffian with a short temper. It can
pulverize anything by swinging around the chain
on its neck.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_1015_000
text:
Munkidori keeps itself somewhere safe while it
toys with its foes, using psychokinesis to induce
intense dizziness.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_1016_000
text:
Fezandipiti beats its glossy wings to scatter
pheromones that captivate people and Pokémon.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_1017_000
text:
This mischief-loving Pokémon is full of curiosity.
It battles by drawing out the type-based energy
contained within its masks.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_1017_001
text:
In this form, it draws on the power of water.
It attacks unrelentingly with kicks and ivy strikes.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_1017_002
text:
In this form, it draws on the power of fire.
It spears its enemies with thorn-covered ivy.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_1017_003
text:
In this form, it draws on the power of stone.
Its body is rock-solid, protecting it from all
manner of attacks.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_1018_000
text:
It digs holes on mountains, searching for food.
It’s so durable that being caught in a cave-in
won’t faze it.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_1019_000
text:
These capricious syrpents have banded together.
On the rare occasion that their moods align,
their true power is unleashed.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_1020_000
text:
It resembles an eerie Pokémon once shown in a
paranormal magazine. That Pokémon was said to
be an Entei regenerated from a fossil.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_1021_000
text:
It bears resemblance to a Pokémon that became
a hot topic for a short while after a paranormal
magazine touted it as Raikou’s ancestor.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_1022_000
text:
It was named after a mysterious object
recorded in an old book. Its body seems
to be metallic.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_1023_000
text:
There was supposedly an incident in which it
launched shining blades to cut everything around
it to pieces. Little else is known about it.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_1024_000
text:
It’s thought that this Pokémon lived in ancient
Paldea until it got caught in seismic shifts and
went extinct.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_1024_001
text:
The shell is made of crystallized Terastal energy.
When struck by a move, this shell absorbs the
move’s energy and transfers it to Terapagos.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_1024_002
text:
An old expedition journal describes the sight of
this Pokémon buried in the depths of the earth as
resembling a planet floating in space.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_1025_000
text:
Its peach-shaped shell serves as storage for
a potent poison. It makes poisonous mochi
and serves them to people and Pokémon.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0900_000
text:
This Pokémon is a rough, crude, and
violent sort. It swings around its large,
heavy stone axes to finish off its prey.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0904_000
text:
It’s ferocious and has a short temper. The ends of
its spikes are barbed, and they can’t be easily
removed once they’ve punctured something.

label: ZKN_VIOLET_0211_001
text:
It absorbs toxins from the food it eats.
The distinct purple spikes on its body are
evidence of its potent poison.
